[LSIG.3.5] Most of the rate use cases for `integral` (flow, power, speed,
current) are dropout-safe only under `gap zero`; an author should specify
`gap zero` explicitly on a rate integral and rely on the `gap hold` default
only for genuinely held quantities. `gap hold` over a dead sensor accrues
without bound (§[LSIG.6]).
